description: The twelve findings of the second security review (target 0.1.0-preview.13) and where each stands (T-1 of operations/FINDINGS-FIX-PLAN-2026-11-14.md). A finding is 'fixed' only with at least one existing test that fails without the fix; an 'open' one names the story that will fix it or says it is undecided. This file is traceability for people; the STRIDE register (threat-register.json) stays the checked security model. tests/unit_review_findings.py keeps it honest.

findings.title: Backup retention treated an unlisted backup as gone, so a list truncated at 100 entries made it forget backups that still existed
Install and upgrade read a file twice (a swap between verification and use), and signatures were not enforced
Sign-in throttling let one visitor lock the administrator out, and trusted the client address wrongly behind a proxy
An operation that used all its attempts wedged its resource, with no way to cancel it
Replaying a Snapshot request with the same idempotency key returned a conflict
A viewer could read any managed VM's serial scrollback
Off-host backup import had no size cap and was listed before it was verified
Roles are enforced only in the HTTP layer: a demoted or disabled user's queued operation still runs
Console hardening gaps: no per-session ticket cap, tickets not revoked on sign-out, no fail-closed on session-store errors, idle-timeout rule undecided
The audit trail lacked the user's identity and failed silently
No general rate limit on authenticated reads
Hypothetical volume and VM operation races (a concurrency test first)
